publicReleaseNotes: Uptime 0.5.21 shows existing monitor tags in both consoles when you create a scoped Monitoring read key. Use tags alone or combine them with selected monitors. A clean local launch installs Chromium before checking the owner sign-in link. The install guides explain the explicit localhost launch for passkeys. The backup guide shows how to verify a native CLI session with a passkey in the browser, and the read API guide includes a tag-scoped key specification with a one-day expiry. The setup guides identify the local RER_OPEN link and the one-time HTTPS link printed by rer signin after hosted setup with mail off. Set-up agents pass the hosted link as sign_in in Uptime’s tools[i] entry in session.report. The README links to the checkout’s release record. This upgrade uses the exact @runeditrun/rer 0.2.125 pin. All 91 SQL migrations from 0.5.20 are byte-identical. This release adds zero migration files and zero required settings. Existing monitors, history, incidents, destinations and private settings are retained. Back up first through Settings > Backup and files > Download backup with a second factor verified within five minutes. Keep private settings and .rer/deploy separately, plus a hosted database backup if applicable. For local CLI backup, verify the native session while dev is running, then stop dev and use the verified UPTIME_ACCESS_COOKIE to run rer export --output exports/uptime.rer within five minutes. Keep the cookie private. Update with pnpm install --frozen-lockfile, stop dev or preview and deploy as usual. Keep the deployment receipt and use the existing installation keys. The mail enable/disable commands, legacy SendGrid selector guidance and known limits in the changelog still apply.
